groups.defect: fetch_error_details zips error_ids with get_multi().values() by position, so missing, reordered or deduplicated results attach the wrong id to the event data.
groups.rationale: All three report the same positional zip mismatch in fetch_error_details and suggest the same fix: look up events by node id. One cites deduplication as the cause, but the defect and the fix are the same.

groups.defect: The feature-flagged TableWidgetVisualization branch is given hardcoded empty columns and tableData, so flagged orgs see empty table widgets.
groups.rationale: Both point at the same lines of the widget chart component and report the same hardcoded empty data. The file paths differ only slightly.

groups.defect: The rewritten useTraceItemAttributeKeys can return undefined attributes (on the first fetch, on error, or when disabled) instead of an always-initialized TagCollection.
groups.rationale: Both report the same lost guarantee that attributes is an object and propose the same `?? {}` default.
